Scope: sewage, storm water (with ponds and open channels), irrigation and potable water networks, 13.8 kV cable, street lighting, telecom ducts, and internal and external roads with asphalt and sidewalks.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. On 15-Nov-2026 the project is 99.23% complete against 99.93% planned, behind by 0.70% (SPI 0.99). This week gained 0.01% (7 of 48,045 man-hours, all in New Scope, which is now complete), against 0.03% the week before. The revised completion date of 26-Sep-2026 has passed.

The revised completion date has passed, and the P6 finish slipped another week: it is now 101 days late. The contract completion was extended by two months to 26-Sep-2026 (CCO 2, approved 29-Jun-2026). The weekly report still forecasts completion on 30-Nov-2026, 65 days late. The P6 update of 15-Nov-2026 (XER) finishes the project on 05-Jan-2027 with −101 days of total float, a week later than the 29-Dec-2026 of the 08-Nov-2026 update. In P6 the storm network still finishes zone by zone, now between 21-Nov and 02-Dec-2026 (Z02, Z08, Z11, Z04, Z05), all works including testing and commissioning on 02-Dec-2026 (01-Dec-2026 last week), and the approval of all as-built drawings on 22-Nov-2026 (15-Nov-2026 last week).

Scope of work: quantities

Revised BOQ quantity and installed quantity for each network, from the Major Quantities sheet of the 15-Nov-2026 weekly report. "This week" is the change from the 08-Nov-2026 report: the sheet is unchanged, so it is 0 for every item. Every listed item is reported as 100% installed.

Revised quantities are far below the original BOQ for roadsThe revised BOQ, still marked "under review", sets each total equal to the installed quantity. For road works it is a small part of the original BOQ: asphalt wearing course 1,240 of 63,689 m³, precast kerb K1-D 15,100 of 187,209 m, kerb L1 1,972 of 123,805 m and interlock 1,576 of 59,537 m².
The sheet conflicts with the P6 updateThe P6 update of 15-Nov-2026 still has 87 open activities on uPVC 300 mm and GRP 400 mm catch-basin lines (excavation, laying, testing or backfilling) on Main Roads and in zones Z02, Z04, Z05, Z06, Z08, Z09, Z10 and Z11, finishing up to 02-Dec-2026. The Z11 lines have not started; in Z04 and Z08 work on further lines started between 09 and 14-Nov-2026. The quantities above therefore overstate what is installed.
Medium-voltage works revised to zeroThe 13.8 kV cable (30,720 m in the original BOQ), its joints and terminations, the 950 m duct bank, the normally-open RMUs and the three street-lighting substations and RMUs all have a revised quantity of 0. They are left out of the table.

Data notes

  • Week number: the Milestones sheet states contract week 120 ("120 of 103"), which is used. Counting whole weeks from site handover (29-Jul-2024) gives 119, because contract weeks count from 1.
  • Major Quantities is unchanged since 18-Oct-2026 and shows every item 100% installed, while the P6 update of 15-Nov-2026 still has 87 catch-basin pipe-line activities open on Main Roads and in eight zones until 02-Dec-2026.
  • The P6 summary in the Progress sheet shows the 08-Nov-2026 schedule (project finish 29-Dec-2026, −94 days, construction finish 01-Dec-2026, Z04 24-Nov and Z05 25-Nov-2026), while the XER of 15-Nov-2026 in the uploaded archive finishes the project on 05-Jan-2027 (−101 days) and construction on 02-Dec-2026 (Z04 01-Dec, Z05 02-Dec-2026). The activity counts in the Schedule sheet match the XER.
  • The weekly report keeps its completion forecast at 30-Nov-2026, while P6 gives 05-Jan-2027. P6 forecasts the "Complete Demobilization" milestone on 15-Nov-2026, while its demobilisation activities run from 13-Dec-2026 to 05-Jan-2027. The weekly report gives the existing-condition survey as finished in July 2025 while P6 still has it open.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet was not updated: its last actual point is still October (47,652 man-hours, stated as 99.25% against 48,012). This report uses the 48,045 budget of the Progress sheet (99.23% on 15-Nov-2026).
  • HSE: 15,300 man-hours are reported for the third week running; 11 toolbox talks were held this week but the cumulative count stays at 3,410.
  • Every sheet of the Progress Layouts PDF of 15-Nov-2026 is stamped "Current Date: 09/08/2026". The Catch Basin Tracking Sheet (.xlsb) has no text version and was not used. The Procurement Tracker is still dated 23-Aug-2026.
  • Photos: only two of the 17 photos carry a date and GPS stamp. "Housekeeping for Open channels (3)" is the same file as last week's, and the two open-channel photos show the same scenes as two of the level-grading photos.
  • Manpower: the October head count (1,092 manual, 92 non-manual) is repeated for the fifth week and does not match the trade breakdown (389); monthly actuals stop at January 2026.
  • The invoice summary shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists 25. The Testing sheet still shows 0% for all systems, while P6 has testing and commissioning in progress until 02-Dec-2026.
  • The workbook also reports cost-based progress (value-weighted) and labels it as planned and actual. This report uses physical % complete (man-hour weighted) only.
